business.name: Ironbark Motor Works
business.directions: Second driveway past the servo, roller door 2.

hero.headline: Mechanics who show you the worn part before they replace it.
hero.lede: Logbook servicing, safety certificates, brakes and diagnostics for every make — done in Ashgrove by the same three people since the day you first came in.

afterHoursNote: Drop your keys in the after-hours slot any time before 7am.

services.title: Logbook servicing
services.blurb: Every item the manufacturer's schedule asks for, stamped in your book with genuine or equivalent-quality parts. Your new car warranty stays exactly as it is.

services.title: Safety certificate (roadworthy)
services.blurb: Queensland safety certificate for selling or re-registering. Booked in half-hour slots, and if something fails we'll quote the repair before you decide.

services.title: Brakes
services.blurb: Pads, rotors, calipers, lines and fluid. We machine rotors in-house where they're still within tolerance, which usually saves a few hundred dollars.

services.title: Diagnostics and check engine lights
services.blurb: Factory-level scan tools for most makes, plus an actual mechanic reading the live data rather than just quoting the code back at you. Fee comes off the repair if you go ahead.

services.title: Air conditioning
services.blurb: Regas, leak testing with dye, condenser and compressor work. Licensed to handle both R134a and the newer R1234yf refrigerant.

services.title: Clutch and transmission
services.blurb: Automatic transmission fluid and filter services, clutch replacement, and CV joint and driveshaft repairs. Big jobs get a written quote and a courtesy car.

services.title: Tyres, wheels and suspension
services.blurb: Fitting, balancing, four-wheel alignment on a Hunter rig, plus shocks, bushes and steering components. We'll show you the alignment printout before and after.

services.title: Pre-purchase inspections
services.blurb: Before you buy someone else's problem: a 120-point check, a scan for stored fault codes, and a phone call from the mechanic who inspected it. We travel within 15 km.

reviews.text: Took the Ranger in for a rattle two other places couldn't find. Dean put it on the hoist, walked me under it and pointed at the broken sway bar link. Fixed the same afternoon for less than I'd budgeted for the diagnosis alone.

reviews.text: I'd been told by the dealer that servicing anywhere else would void my warranty. Priya explained the actual law, stamped the book, and saved me $310 on the 60,000. Three services later and my warranty is completely fine.

reviews.text: They texted me a photo of the worn brake pad next to a new one before doing anything. First mechanic in twenty years who made me feel like I wasn't being taken for a ride. The courtesy car was clean, too.

faq.q: Will servicing here void my new car warranty?
faq.a: No. Australian Consumer Law has prohibited that since 2010. As long as the service follows the manufacturer's schedule and uses parts of the correct specification, your warranty is unaffected. We stamp your logbook and keep the documentation on file in case anyone ever asks.

faq.q: How long does a logbook service take?
faq.a: Two to three hours for most cars. Book it in the morning and it's usually ready by early afternoon. If we find something that needs attention we'll call you with a price before doing any extra work.

faq.q: Can I wait while it's done?
faq.a: For safety certificates and quick jobs, yes — there's a waiting room with decent coffee and wifi. For a full service you're better off taking a courtesy car or letting us drop you home if you're within 5 km.

faq.q: Do you work on European cars?
faq.a: Yes. Marco has fifteen years on Volkswagen, Audi and BMW, and we have the factory-level diagnostic software for those makes plus Mercedes-Benz. Parts sometimes take an extra day to arrive.

Priya is high-voltage certified and we're set up for hybrid servicing and EV brake, suspension, tyre and 12-volt system work. We don't do high-voltage battery pack repairs — that goes back to the manufacturer.

faq.q: What if I can't afford the repair right now?
faq.a: Tell us. We'll separate the list into what makes the car unsafe, what will get worse and more expensive if it waits, and what can genuinely be left for six months. Afterpay is available on jobs over $300.
